text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Indeed...
I believe I was able to show my running style.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
If I keep winning in the Central,
eventually my name will reach my hometown—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what kind of Umamusume is that Oguri Cap
who was running just now?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Who knows... Apparently there were rumors on the local circuit.
Not that I knew anything about them, though.

On the way back to the academy
with Oguri Cap after her successful Debut—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer.
What should I do after this?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I know running in the race should be enough.
And yet... is that truly all I need to do?

Oguri Cap was lost in thought.
She's probably dwelling on what
she heard from the crowd after the race.
Indeed, while she was a hot topic within the Academy, her public recognition was still far from enough. If so—
choice_data_list: Anyway, you just need to enter a lot of races.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A lot...?
Does that mean running a whole bunch?

If there are still people who don't know Oguri Cap,
then all we have to do is show them her strength and charm.
choice_data_list: Let's go tell them "Oguri has arrived in the JRA!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I want to run. Enough for my name
to reach all the way back home!

A light shines in Oguri Cap's eyes.
There is no doubt she'll put on
a fantastic performance in the upcoming race.
